seed.title: Evidence-hash vote cap
seed.text: Admit at most one council vote per evidence-bundle hash per round. The hash is SHA-256 of the canonical evidence bytes.

mutants.title: ProofDigestBallotLimiter
mutants.text: Admit at most one council vote per evidence-bundle hash per round. The hash is SHA-256 of the canonical evidence bytes.

mutants.title: Sitting-scoped solitary ballot keyed by exhibit checksum
mutants.text: Permit a solitary ballot keyed by a proof-pack digest each cycle. Digests equal a 256-bit checksum of normalised exhibit payload.

mutants.title: Evidence-hash vote cap (max_votes=2)
mutants.text: Admit at most two council votes per evidence-bundle hash per round. The hash is SHA-256 of the canonical evidence bytes.

mutants.title: Evidence-hash vote cap, reordered pipeline
mutants.text: Admit at most one council vote per evidence-bundle hash per round. The hash is SHA-256 of the canonical evidence bytes.

mutants.title: Partition leak check before synthesis
mutants.text: Split participants into isolated partitions. A finding may not cite a fact that only another partition received.
